name: io.github.youthmy11-ai/forgesuite-mcp
title: ForgeSuite DevSecOps, Web3 Risk & Crypto FinOps MCP Server
description: Zero-dependency Node.js 22+ stdio MCP server (v1.1.0, 6 tools): .env secret leak scanner, EVM calldata/risk decoder, LLM token cost calculator, crypto invoice URI generator, live EVM token/proxy/opcode risk scanner, and live Solana SPL/Token-2022 mint risk scanner.

tools.name: envshield_scan
tools.description: Scan .env, JSON, YAML, or code snippets offline for leaked API keys, private keys, mnemonics, JWTs, and webhook secrets.

tools.name: calldata_decode
tools.description: Decode raw hexadecimal EVM transaction calldata (ERC-20, Permit2, Uniswap, Multisend) and flag unlimited approvals.

tools.name: tokencost_estimate
tools.description: Calculate per-call and monthly LLM/agent token spend across frontier models with prompt-caching discounts.

tools.name: cryptobill_quote
tools.description: Generate deterministic self-custody crypto invoice links and Solana Pay SPL-USDC / EIP-681 BEP20 / TRON payment URIs.

tools.name: evm_token_risk_scan
tools.description: Live EVM token and smart contract bytecode, EIP-1967/1167 proxy, opcode (SELFDESTRUCT/DELEGATECALL), and rug/honeypot selector audit across Base, Ethereum, BSC, and Arbitrum.

tools.name: solana_mint_risk_scan
tools.description: Live Solana Mainnet SPL Token and Token-2022 mintAuthority, freezeAuthority, permanentDelegate, transferFeeConfig, transferHook, and Top-10 holder concentration risk audit.
